thesis: Solana has the best fresh regulatory catalyst in the book - the SEC formally recognised SOL alongside bitcoin and ether for commodity-based trusts on 5 Sep 2026 - and the network data is genuinely strong. But the two flow sources I found flatly contradict each other, and price is sitting on its breakout level rather than above it. Catalyst without confirming structure is a watch, not a buy.
bull_case: The SEC formally recognised Solana alongside BTC and ETH for commodity-based trusts on 5 Sep 2026 - a regulatory category change, not a headline. Bitwise's Solana staking ETF (BSOL) passed $1B cumulative inflows as of 25 Aug 2026. Network data supports the story: ~9.5M new addresses per day, exchange supply down 4.91%, and Solana led all chains with $229M of 30-day real-world-asset net inflows. The Alpenglow consensus upgrade targets ~150ms finality. Packet: close 105.13, close > SMA50 > SMA200, 3m momentum +28.3%, RSI 58 - room above, not overbought.
bear_case: The evidence conflicts and I could not resolve it: one source reports SOL ETF inflows extending a 10-11 day streak with $153.87M, the strongest week since October 2025, while another reports Solana product inflows falling 73-96% in the week ending 4 Sep. Both are dated within days of each other. When the central pillar of a bull case cannot be verified, size accordingly. Price is the tiebreaker and it is unhelpful: 105.13 against a cited breakout level of 103.35 is sitting on support, not breaking out, and the packet flags no 55-day high. ATR 5.1% is the widest of our holdings. Base rate from our own backtest (research/backtests/2026-09-06.md, 730 days, generated 2026-09-06): the crypto sleeve returned -6.4% with Sharpe -0.15, a 17% win rate over 75 trades and a -19.2% max drawdown, while us_stocks returned +7.6% (Sharpe 0.63) and au_stocks +3.7% (Sharpe 0.57) on the same rules. Trend-break exits alone lost 1,028 in crypto across 39 trades. This system has no demonstrated edge trading crypto momentum, and out-of-sample being +5.3% on a short window is not proof that it does. Every crypto conviction below is capped by that.
catalysts: Follow-through from the 5 Sep 2026 SEC commodity-trust recognition
Weekly SOL ETF flow prints, which would settle the contradiction above
risks: Contradictory ETF flow reporting: unresolved as of today
Price sitting on the breakout level rather than above it
ATR 5.1%, the widest stop distance in the book
Own backtest: negative expectancy for crypto momentum in this system
invalidation: Flips long on a daily close above 123 (the level sources name as the gate to $150) with one clean week of positive SOL ETF flows; the bear case confirms on a close below 94.40, which breaks the late-August breakout structure.
